Theorem
[Ricci decay implies a Euclidean cone (Theorem 27.52)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0050 1. ch27:27.52\group Shrinker geometry at infinity

If $|\Rc |(x)\to 0$ at infinity on a complete noncompact shrinker, then the metric is asymptotic to a Euclidean cone over a smooth closed manifold.
